Head_and_Face: Moderately long ears with dark tips, proportionally sized relative to head.
Large laterally positioned eyes providing wide field of view.
Twitching nose with split upper lip.
Body_and_Plumage: Compact rounded body with small, stubby proportions.
Dense soft fur in greyish-brown coloration providing cryptic camouflage.
Short fluffy tail with distinctive white underside visible during flight.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Elongated muscular hind legs adapted for saltatorial locomotion.
Shorter forelegs with clawed digits for digging.

Head_and_Face: Exceptionally long ears with black tips, markedly longer than rabbit ears.
Body_and_Plumage: Elongated body with powerful hind limbs, notably larger than rabbit.
Dense fur in brown, gray, or seasonal white coloration.
Short tail.
Larger than rabbit with longer ears and legs.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Massively elongated hind legs with muscular thighs enabling rapid leaping.

Head_and_Face: Long tufted ears with fur.
Pink or blue eyes in albino strains.
Body_and_Plumage: Compact rounded body with small, lightweight proportions.
Exceptionally long silky white fur of remarkable length relative to body size.
Dense fine wool-like fur requiring regular grooming.
Small fur-covered tail.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Muscular hind legs concealed beneath abundant coat.

Head_and_Face: Broad head with prominent cheek pouches extending to shoulders.
Small dark eyes.
Rounded relatively large ears.
Body_and_Plumage: Stocky compact body with diminutive, rounded proportions.
Dense short fur in golden, brown, black, or white coloration.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Short legs with clawed digits; hind feet slightly elongated.

Head_and_Face: Small head with short ears.
Small eyes and nose.
Body_and_Plumage: Stocky robust body with heavily built proportions.

Dark brown to black coloration with contrasting white or yellow quill bands.
Short quill-covered tail.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Short stout legs with strong claws for climbing.
Quills keratinous with barbed tips that detach easily upon contact.

Head_and_Face: Small rounded ears without tufts.
Large dark eyes.

Grizzled gray-brown fur dorsally with orange-brown underparts.
Long bushy tail comprising approximately half body length with mixed gray, brown, and black hairs.

Small dark eyes.

Coarse dense fur in brown, gray, or reddish coloration.
Thick fur providing insulation for hibernation.
Short bushy tail.

Head_and_Face: Broad head with small eyes and ears.
Large orange-pigmented continuously growing incisors for gnawing wood.

Dense waterproof double coat with dark brown coloration.
Broad flat paddle-shaped scaly tail of substantial length relative to body.

Shorter forelegs with dexterous claws for manipulation.

Large prominent eyes.

No visible tail.

Arched muscular neck.

Uniform brownish-orange to light chestnut coat coloration with no black points.
Mane and tail same color as body or lighter (flaxen).
Deep-chested body with strong back.
Long tail with flowing hair.
